m: 1. अभि-√ 1. पा to drink of Gobh.
2. अभि-√ 2. पा -पाति, to guard, RV.; VS.; to behold with attention, RV. viii, 59, 3 : Caus. P. -पालयति, to protect, assist, MBh. &c.
अभि-पाण्डु mfn. quite pale, Kir.
अभि-पाण्डु—ता (f.)
अभि-पाल m. protector, MBh.
अभि-पालन n. protecting, R.
अभि-पालिन् see गृहाभ्˚ (p. 362).
अभि-पात m. hastening near, Kād.
अभि-पातिन् mfn. hastening near
running to the help of (in comp.), MBh. iii, 284.

अभि-√ पॄ (Imper. 2. sg. -पृणीहि) to fill up, PārGṛ.; -पूर्यते, to become full or abundant, PārGṛ.; MBh. : Caus. -पूरयति, to make full, fill, ŚBr. &c.; to load with, Kathās.; to cover with (as with arrows), MBh. vi, 1721; to present with (instr.), Hariv.; Kathās.; (said of sorrows, &c.) to fill the heart of any one, overwhelm; to accomplish, R. vii, 35, 14.
a: अभिपॄ — {c3c} {c9c} P. To fill. --pass. To become full. --Caus. 1 To fill, make full. --2 To load with (as animals); cover with. --3 To present with. --4 To overwhelm, overpower, master completely; शोको मामभ्यपूरयत् Rām.

m: अभि-√ पीड् to oppress, torment.
अभि-पीडित mfn. pressed (as the soil by the foot or by an army), ṢaḍvBr. &c.
oppressed, tormented, afflicted, MBh. &c.
अभि-पीत mfn. watered (as the earth by rain), MBh. xii, 12844.
अभि-√ पू -पवते, to flow purified towards or for (acc. or dat.), RV.; to blow towards, TS.; TBr.; to make bright, glorify, AV.; TS.
अभि-√ पूज् to honour, reverence greatly; to approve of.
a: अभिपूज् — {c10c} P. 1 To adorn, worship. --2 To honour; approve, assent to; तथेति भरतो वाक्यं वसिष्ठस्याभिपूज्य तत् Rām. ; Ms. 6. 58.
अभिपूजनं — Honouring; approving.

m: अभि-पूजित mfn. honoured
approved, assented to, Mn. vi, 58, &c.
अभि-पूर्ण mfn. full of (instr. or gen.)

v: na॰ aByAsena aBito vA pUraRam prA॰ sa॰ । aByAsena sarvataH pUraRe “aBiplavAByAsenABipUraRam” kAtyA॰ 24, 3, 33, ।
m: अभि-पूरण n. filling, KātyŚr.
a: अभिपूरणं — Filling, overpowering.

m: अभि-पूर्त n. that which has been fulfilled, AV. ix, 5, 13.
अभि-पूर्व mfn. following in regular order, PBr.
a: अभिपूर्वं — ind. One after another, successively.

m: अभि-पूर्वम् ind. in regular order, successively. [AV.; ŚBr.]
अभि-पूर्वेण ind. in regular order, successively. [PBr.]
अभि-पूर्य mfn. to be filled, MaitrS.
अभि-√ पश् -पश्यति, to look upon or at, view, RV. &c.; to perceive, notice, MBh. i, 5002, &c.; (with gen.), BhP.; to know, ChUp.
अभि-पठित mfn. denominated, named, Suśr.
अभि-√ पच् to boil up (as milk), Suśr.

अभि-√ पद् to come near or towards, approach; to approach (a deity) for imploring her help, Śiś. ix, 27; to come up (as an auxiliary), assist; to seize, catch, overpower, master, RV. x, 71, 9; ŚBr. &c.; to take possession of Mn. i, 30, &c.; to accept, R.; to undertake, devote one's self to (acc.)
a: अभिपद् — {c4c} A. 1 To go to, draw near, approach (with acc.); रावणावरजा तत्र राघवं मदनातुरा . अभिपेदे निदाघार्ता व्यालीव मलयद्रुमं .. R. 12. 32; 19. 11; Dk. 166; K. 265; to enter (into) Śi. 3. 25; sometimes with loc. also. --2 To look upon, consider, regard; to take or know to be; क्षणमभ्यपद्यत जनैर्न मृषा गगनं गणाधिपतिमूर्तिरिति Śi. 9. 27. --3 To help, assist; मयाभिपन्नं तं चापि न सर्पो धर्षयिष्यति Mb. --4 To seize, catch hold of; overpower, attack, subdue, take possession of, overcome, afflict; सर्वतश्चाभिपन्नैषा धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः, चंडवाताभिपन्नानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः Mb.; see अभिपन्न also. --5 (a) To take, assume; Ms. 1. 30. (b) To accept, receive; निरास्वाद्यतमं शून्यं (राज्यं) भरतो नाभिपत्स्यते Rām. --6 To apply or devote oneself to, undertake, fall to, observe; स चिंतामभ्यपद्यत Rām. --7 To honour.

m: अभि-पद्म mfn. (said of elephants) having red spots on the skin, MBh. i, 7013.
a: अभिपद्म — a. Very beautiful.

m: अभि-पले (√ इ) to follow after any one running away (acc.), PBr. (cf. पले.)

s: tri, (aBi + pad + karttari ktaH .) aparAdDaH । aparADavAn । vyApadgataH । prAptavipattiH । aBigrastaH । SatruRAkrAntaH । ityamaraH ॥ (svIkftaH । aNgIkftaH । aBiBUtaH । pIqitaH । “dAhaprapAkO SiSirABinandAH । pittABipannenayane Bavanti” । “dfzwirdozABipannA” । iti suSrute .)
v: tri॰ aBi + pada--kta । 1 aparADavati, 2 Apadgate, 3 svIkfte, 4 ABimuKyena gate ca ।
m: अभि-पन्न mfn. approaching for imploring the help of L.
assisted, MBh. &c.
seized, overpowered, ŚBr. &c.
undertaking, taking in hand
undertaken, taken in hand
one who has acted wrongly towards (in comp.), MBh. xii, 68, 50 and 58
distant, L.
dead, L.
a: अभिपन्न — p. p. 1 Gone or come near, approached, run towards, gone to (a state &c.); त्वमन्यमाकारमिवाभिपन्नः Ki. 3. 46. --2 Fled, fugitive, seeking refuge with. --3 Subdued, overpowered, afflicted, seized &c.; कालाभिपन्नाः सीदंति सिकतासेतवो यथा Rām.; यदिदं सर्वं मृत्युनाभिपन्नं Śat. Br.; दोष˚, कश्मल˚, व्याघ्र˚ &c. --4 Unfortunate, fallen into difficulties &c. --5 Accepted. --6 Guilty. --7 Removed to a distance. --8 Dead.

m: अभि-परा-√ वद् to speak to, address, ŚBr.; KauṣBr.
अभि-परीत mfn. (√ इ), filled or taken with, seized by (instr., in comp.), MBh. &c.
अभि-परी-वृत mfn. (√ वृ), filled or taken with (instr.; as with anger), R.
अभि-परे (√ इ), (Imper. 2. sg. -परेहि) to go away towards (acc.), AV. xiv, 2, 34 and 35.
अभि-परि-ग्लान mfn. (√ ग्लै), tired, exhausted, MBh. i, 4489.
अभि-परि-√ ग्रह् to clasp, embrace, MānGṛ.
अभि-परि-हार m. moving round, (अन्- neg.), ĀśvŚr.
अभि-परि-√ हन् to overpower entirely, ŚBr.
अभि-परि-√ हृ P. to move round (in a circle), ŚBr. : P. with आत्मानम् [Kauś.] or Caus. Ā. (Opt. 3. pl. -हारयेरन्) [ĀśvŚr.] to move round one's self.
अभि-परिप्लुत mfn. overflowed with (as मेदसा, रजसा [said of a wife during menstruation, MBh. iii, 523; cf. अभि-प्लुत below], &c.)
attacked, afflicted by (instr.; as by anger, sorrow, compassion, &c.), MBh. &c.
a: अभिपरिप्लुत — a. Overflowed, filled with, inundated; (fig.) overwhelmed, affected; attacked; shaken; शोकेन, मन्युना &c.

m: अभि-परि-ष्वञ्ज् (√ स्वञ्ज्), (p. -ष्वजत्) to embrace, R.
अभि-पर्य्-आ-√ धा (= पर्य्-आ-√ धा, q.v.), to surround (as a pan with fire), ŚBr.
अभि-पर्य्-आ-√ सिच् to pour out round, AitBr.
अभि-पर्यावर्त m. turning towards, coming near, MaitrS.
अभि-पर्य्-आ-√ वृत् Ā. to turn one's self towards (acc.), AV.; TS. &c.; to turn one's self round (acc.), AitBr.
अभि-पर्य्-√ 1. ऊह् अभि पर्य् ऊहते, to carry or bring towards (acc.), TS.
अभि-पर्य्-ए (√ इ), (said of the time) ‘to pass round’ (acc.) i.e. to pass away or elapse, ŚBr.
1. अभि-√ 1. पत् -पत्यते, to be lord over (acc.), RV. viii, 102, 9; pr. p. -पात्यमान, possessing, RV. x, 132, 3.

2. अभि-√ 2. पत् to fly near, hasten near; to rush towards, assail; to fall down upon (acc.), AV. vi, 124, 1 and 2 (aor. अभ्य्-अपप्त & अभ्य्-अपप्तत्), &c.; to fall or come into (acc.); to fly through or over, MBh. v, 3051; to overtake in flying, MBh. viii, 1910 : Caus. -पातयति, to throw after with (instr.), TBr. ; to throw upon (dat. or loc.); to throw down; to pass (time).
a: अभिपत् — {c1c} P. 1 To fly near, go or hasten near, approach; हंतुमभिपतति पांडुसुतं Ki. 12. 36; अधिरोढुमस्तगिरिमभ्यपतत् Śi. 9. 1; Dk. 72, 128; Mk. 9. 12; Ki. 10. 42. --2 To fall upon, attack, assail; यंता गजस्याभ्यपतद्गजस्थं R. 7. 37; Dk. 62, 70, 96; Ki. 7. 19. --3 To fall down, fall (as tears). --4 To fall into, enter or come into. --5 To overtake in flying. --6 To pass over, traverse. --7 To get, back, withdraw, retire; Śi. 7. 51; Ki. 10. 54. --8 (4A.) To be lord or master of (Ved.). --Caus. To throw upon, throw down into; ज्वलनमभिपातयामि Ve. 6.

m: अभि-पतन n. flying towards.
a: अभिपतनं — 1 Approaching. --2 Falling upon, assault, attack. --3 Going forth, departure.

m: अभि-पत्ति f. seizing, ŚBr.
possession
a: अभिपत्तिः — f. 1 Approaching, drawing near. --2 Completion.

m: अभि-पत्ति—मत् mfn. possessed of Jātakam.
अभि-पृष्ठे ind. at the back of, behind, Kum.
अभि-पृष्ट mfn. inquired after, BhP.
अभि-पिङ्गल mfn. ‘very red’, reddish-brown, Hariv.
अभि-√ पिश् (impf. -अपिंशत्, perf. Ā. 3. pl. -पिपिश्रे) to adorn with (instr.), RV. v, 60, 4; x, 68, 11; TBr.

m: अभि-पित्व n. (cf. अप-पित्व), approaching, visiting, putting up (for the night at an inn), RV.
(with or without the gen. pl. अह्नाम्) close or departure of the day, evening, RV.
अभि-पित्व See अभि-√ 2. पत्.
a: अभिपित्वं — a. or s. Ved. [पा भावे कित्वन्] 1 Come, approaching ( अभिप्राप्त). --2 Visiting, putting up (for the night at an inn &c.); the time of coming. --3 Approaching time. --4 Close or departure of day, evening. --5 Dawn sacrifice.

m: अभि-प्लव m. N. of a religious ceremony (lasting six days and performed five times during the sacrifice Gavām-ayana), ŚBr. &c.
a kind of aquatic bird, Viṣṇ.
a: अभिप्लवः — 1 Affliction, disturbance. --2 Inundation, overflowing. --3 N. of a religious ceremony performed as part of the sacrifice गवामयन. --4 N. of the Prājāpatya Āditya.

m: अभि-√ प्लु to swim or navigate towards, approach, ŚBr. &c.; to overflow, &c. (see अभि-प्लुत); to jump near to, Hariv. &c.: Caus. (said of the sea) to wash, Kauś.
a: अभिप्लु — {c4c} A. 1 To go up to, jump or leap towards. --2 To over flow; (fig.) affect, fill with, overwhelm; तमसाभिप्लुते लोके रजसा च Mb.; रजसाभिप्लुतां नारीं Ms. 4. 41 being in her courses; Y. 2. 50. --3 To spring to or over, spring upon. --Caus. To wash or ripple against.

v: tri॰ aBi + pluta--kta । 1 sarvatovyApte 2 aBitaH sikte ca ।
m: अभि-प्लुत mfn. overflowed, overrun
overwhelmed, affected by, labouring under (instr.), MBh. &c.
(रजसा, said of a wife during menstruation; cf. अभि-परि-प्लुत above), Mn. iv, 41.
अभि-प्राण् (√ अन्), -प्राणिति to exhale, breathe forth towards (acc.), ŚBr.; to exhale, breathe forth, AitBr.; TBr. &c.
अभि-प्राणन n. exhaling (opposed to अपानन, q.v.), L.
a: अभिप्राणनं — Exhaling (opp. अपाननं)

m: अभि-प्राश् (√ 2. अश्), to eat in addition to (acc.) another thing (in order to get rid of the taste of it), ChUp.
अभि-प्राप् (√ आप्) to reach, obtain, ŚBr.; ChUp.
a: अभिप्राप्, --प्तिः — &c. = प्राप् q. v.

m: अभि-प्रापण See अर्थाभिप्रापण.
अभि-प्राप्त mfn. reached, obtained.

v: strI ABimuKyena prAptiH prA॰ sa॰ । 1 ABimuKyena prAptO aBipitvaSabde udAhftaM niruktavAkyam ।
m: अभि-प्राप्ति f. arrival, Nir.
अभि-प्रार्थ् (√ अर्थ्) to long for, wish, R.
अभि-प्रार्च् (√ अर्च्) to celebrate in song, RV. viii, 49, 1 and 69, 4.
अभि-प्रास् (√ 2. अस्), to throw upon (acc.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

m: अभि-प्रातर् ind. towards morning, early, ŚBr. xiv
(according to some Comm. ‘on the fourth day early in the morning’).

m: अभि-प्राय See अभि-प्रे.
अभि-प्राय m. aim, Pāṇ. i, 3, 72
purpose, intention, wish, R. &c.
opinion, Mn. vii, 57, &c.
meaning, sense (as of a word or of a passage).
a: अभिप्राय — a. [इ-अच्] Going near, approaching; aiming at, intending, meaning, accruing to; कर्माभिप्राये क्रियाफले P. I. 3. 72. --यः 1 Aim, purpose, object, intention, wish, desire; अभिप्राया न सिद्ध्यंति तेनेदं वर्तते जगत् Pt. 1. 158; साभिप्रायाणि वचांसि Pt. 2 earnest words; भावः कवेरभिप्रायः --2 Meaning, sense, import, implied sense of a word, passage &c.; तेषामयमभिप्रायः such is the meaning intended, import (of the passage &c.). --3 Opinion, belief. --4 Relation, reference. --5 N. of Viṣṇu.

k.v: निर्वेश उपभोगः स्यात्परिसर्पः परिक्रिया। विधुरं तु प्रविश्लेषेऽभिप्रायश्छन्द आशयः॥

v: tri॰ aBiprIRAti aBi + prI--kvip । 1 sarvatastarpake “tuByaM vAtA aBipriyastuyaM marzanti sinDavaH” f॰ 9, 31, 3
m: 1. अभि-√ प्री Caus. to gladden, refresh, Car.
2. अभि-प्री mfn. gladdening, RV. i, 162, 3 and ix, 31, 3.
अभि-प्रीत mfn. pleased, (अन्- neg.), AitBr.
अभि-प्रीति f. pleasing, pleasure, PBr.
a: अभिप्रीतिः — f. Wish; rejoicing.

m: अभि-प्र-√ भू (Ved. Inf. aor. अभि-प्र-भूषणि) to assist, RV. x, 132, 1.
अभि-प्र-भङ्गिन् mfn. (√ भञ्ज्), breaking completely, RV. viii, 45, 35.
अभि-प्र-√ भृ (1. pl. -भरामहे) to offer to (dat.), RV. iv, 56, 5; (Imper. 2. sg. -भर) to throw, dart, RV. viii, 89, 4.
अभि-√ प्रछ् to ask or inquire after, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-धर्षण n. oppressing, injuring, MBh. iii, 14937.
अभि-प्र-णी (√ नी), (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -णेषि) to bring towards (acc.), RV. i, 31, 18.
a: अभिप्रणी — {c1c} P. To lead to, bring towards; consecrate; जज्वाल लोकस्थितये स राजा यथाध्वरे वह्निरभिप्रणीतः Bk. 1. 4.

v: pu॰ aBitaH praRItaH । sarvataH vedaviDinA saMskfte vahnyAdO “jajvAla lokasTitaye sa rAjA yaTADvare vahniraBipraRItaH” BawwiH ।
m: अभि-प्रणीत mfn. brought to (as fire to the altar), Bhaṭṭ. (cf. प्र-णी.)
अभि-प्र-णद् (√ नद्), (perf. 3. pl. -णेदुः) to begin to roar or sound, Bhaṭṭ.
अभि-प्र-णक्ष् (√ नक्ष्), (perf. Ā. -ननक्षे) to overpower, RV. viii, 51, 8.
अभि-प्र-णम् (√ नम्) to bow before (dat. or acc.), MBh. &c.
अभि-प्रणत mfn. bent, bowing before.
अभि-प्रणय m. affection, L. (cf. प्रणय.)
a: अभिप्रणयः — Affection, favour, propitiation.

v: na॰ aBitaH sarvataH praRayanaM saMskAraH । vedaviDinA agnyAdeH saMskAre ।
a: अभिप्रणयनं — Consecrating by sacred hymns.

m: अभि-प्र-णु (√ 4. नु), (aor. Ā. 3. pl. -अनूषत) to shout towards, praise highly, RV. iv, 32, 9 : Intens. (1. pl. -णोनुमस् [frequently]; perf. 3. pl. -णोनुवुः) id., RV.
अभि-प्र-√ शंस् to praise highly, MBh.
अभि-प्रश्निन् mfn. inclined to ask, inquisitive, VS.
अभि-प्रश्निन् See अभि-√ प्रछ्.
a: अभिप्रश्निन् — a. Ved. Desirous of asking many questions.

m: अभि-प्र-√ शुध् Caus. -शोधयति, to clean thoroughly, Suśr.
अभि-प्र-√ श्वस् to blow towards (acc.), AitBr.
अभि-√ प्रथ् (perf. Ā. -पप्रथे) to spread, extend itself towards (acc.), RV. ix, 80, 3 : Caus. -प्रथयति, to spread or scatter over (acc.), TS.; to spread (as one's fame), MBh.
अभि-प्रथन n. spreading over, L.
a: अभिप्रथनं — Spreading or extending over, throwing over.

m: अभि-प्र-√ बुध् Ā. -बुध्यते, to feel, experience, Hir.
अभि-प्र-√ चक्ष् (Ved. Inf. -चक्षे) to see, RV. i, 113, 6.
अभि-प्र-√ चुद् Caus. -चोदयति, to impel, induce, persuade, MBh.; R.
अभि-प्र-√ च्यु (Imper. 2. sg. Ā. -च्यवस्व) to move towards, arrive at (acc.), VS.; TS.

अभि-प्र-√ दॄ (perf. 3. pl. -दद्रुर् = अभि-जग्मुः, Sāy. fr. -√ 2. द्रा, ‘to run towards’) to put forth by bursting or opening, RV. iv, 19, 5 : Pass. -दीर्यते, to be scattered or divided asunder, MBh. viii, 3976.

a: अभिप्रदक्षिणं — ind. Towards the right.

m: अभि-प्र-दक्षिणम् ind. to the right (e.g. with √ 1. कृ, to circumambulate keeping the object on the right), R.
अभि-प्र-दर्शन n. pointing out, indicating, Sāh.
अभि-प्र-√ दृश् Caus. -दर्शयति, to point to (acc.), Jātakam.
अभि-प्र-√ दिश् Caus. -देशयति, to urge on R.
अभि-प्र-√ 2. द्रा See -√ दॄ.
अभि-प्र-√ 2. द्रु (perf. Ā. -दुद्रुवे) to rush towards (acc.), assail, MBh.
अभि-प्र-√ गाह् -गाहते, to dip or plunge into, penetrate, RV. ix, 99, 2 and 110, 2 : Caus. (ind.p. -गाह्य) to immerse, dip, ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभि-प्र-√ गै (Imper. 2. pl. -गायत) to begin to praise, RV.
अभि-प्र-√ 2. हा -जिहीते, to jump or fly upwards in the direction of (acc.), ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभि-प्र-√ हन् (3. pl. -घ्नन्ति) to overpower, RV. vi, 46, 10; ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-हत mfn. struck at, hurt, Suśr.
अभि-प्र-हित mfn. (√ हि), sent hither, AV. x, 1, 15.

v: strI aBitaH satataM prajYA cintanam । satatacintane “tamaSanAyApipAse abrUtAmAvAByABiprajAnIhi” E॰ BA॰ aBiprajAnohi cintayeti vyAKyAnAttasyAstaTArTatvam ।
a: अभिप्रज्ञा — Thinking constantly of.

m: अभि-प्र-√ जन् (3. pl. Ā. -जायन्ते) to bring forth, bear, RV. v, 19, 1 : Caus. -जनयति, to generate for the sake of (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-√ ज्वल् (perf. -जज्वाल) to flare up, MBh.
अभि-प्र-√ काश् -काशते, to become visible, MBh. (चक्षुषा, ‘to the eye’), R.
अभि-प्र-√ कम्प् Caus. -कम्पयति, to stir, allure, ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to go up to (acc.), ŚBr.; Kauś.
अभि-प्र-क्रम्य mfn. to be stepped upon or walked on PBr.
अभि-प्र-√ क्षल् -क्षालयति, to clean thoroughly, polish up (as a jewel), Vikr.
अभि-प्र-√ क्षर् to stream towards (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-क्षरित mfn. poured out, ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-√ मथ् Caus. -मन्थयति, to churn thoroughly, Suśr.
अभि-प्र-√ मन् Ā. (3. pl. -मन्वते) to take any one for, look upon him as, AV. vi, 84, 1.
अभि-प्र-√ 1. मन्द् (1. and 2. sg. Ā. -मन्दे, -मन्दसे; perf. P. 3. pl. -मन्दुः) to gladden, RV.; P. (Imper. 2. sg. -मन्द) to confuse, infatuate, RV. vi, 18, 9.
अभि-प्र-√ मृश् (Imper. 2. sg. -मृस; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -मृक्षस् and 2. pl. -मृक्षत) to seize, grasp: Intens. (p. nom. m. -मर्मृशत्) id., RV. i, 140, 5.

v: strI aBipramUrcCati AhutidAnena vahniranayA । 1 aBi + pra + mUrcCa karaRe kvip । juhvAm ।
m: अभि-प्र-मुर् mfn. (√ मॄ), bruising, crushing, RV. x, 115, 2.
a: अभिप्रमुर् — f. The tongue of fire (जुहू); completely raised.

m: अभि-प्र-√ पॄ -पूर्यते, to be filled, fill one's self completely, MBh. xv, 678.
अभि-प्र-√ पीड् Caus. -पीडयति, to cause pain, torture, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-√ पश् (impf. -प्रापश्यत्) to look out after (acc.), RV. x, 113, 4.
अभि-प्र-√ पच् Pass. -पच्यते, ‘to get ripe’, develop itself, Suśr.
अभि-प्र-√ पद् to come towards, reach at, enter into (acc.), ŚBr. &c.; to resort to (acc.), MBh. &c.; to undertake, MBh.
a: अभिप्रपद् — = प्रपद् q. v.

m: अभि-प्रपन्न mfn. approached, attained.
अभि-प्र-√ रुह् to put forth or produce shoots, Suśr.
अभि-प्र-सारण n. stretching out the feet towards (gen.), Āp.

अभि-प्र-√ स्था (aor. Subj. 2. pl. -स्थात; perf. 3. pl. -तस्थुः) to start or advance towards, reach, RV.; AV. &c.; to surpass, have the precedence of (with or without acc.), RV. i, 74, 8 and x, 65, 15; (cf. अति-प्र-√ स्था) : Caus. to drive (as the cattle to pasture), ChUp.
अभि-प्र-स्थित mfn. one who has set out, started, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-√ 1. सू (3. pl. -सुवन्ति) to drive towards (acc.), Nir.
1. अभि-प्र-सूत mfn. engaged, induced, ordered, Nir.
2. अभि-प्र-सूत mfn. (√ 4. सु), generated, born, MBh. v, 964.

अभि-प्र-√ सद् (p. -सीदत्; perf. 3. pl. -सेदुः) to sit down or settle along (acc.), RV. iv, 1, 13 and x, 32, 1 : Caus. -सादयति, to cause to be well-disposed or gracious, pray for grace or favour, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-√ सह् to be able to (Inf.), Kir. xii, 18.
अभि-प्रसन्न mfn. believing in (loc. or gen.), Divyāv.
अभि-प्र-√ सृ Caus. (ind.p. -सार्य) to stretch one's self out towards (acc.), ŚBr.; Ā. (Pot. -सारयीत) to stretch out (as a foot) towards or upon (loc.), Āp.
अभि-प्र-√ सृप् (p. -सर्पत्) to creep near, AV. viii, 6, 22.
अभि-प्र-सृत mfn. devoted to, R. (cf. प्रसृत.)
अभि-प्र-√ स्कन्द् to jump into (acc.), ŚāṅkhBr.
अभि-प्र-√ स्तृ to scatter, ŚBr.
अभि-प्र-√ स्तु to praise with a स्तोम (q.v.), TS.
अभि-प्र-सुप्त mfn. (√ स्वप्), fallen asleep, MBh.
अभि-प्रतारिन् m. N. of a descendant of Kakṣa-sena, ChUp.
अभि-प्र-√ तन् to spread over (acc.), KauṣUp.
अभि-प्रतप्त mfn. ‘intensely heated’, dried up, Suśr.
exhausted with pain or fever, R.
a: अभिप्रतप्त — a. 1 Intensely heated. --2 Dried up. --3 Exhausted with pain, fever &c.

m: अभि-प्रति-√ 1. गॄ ‘to call out to (acc.) alternately’, answer in singing, TS.; (cf. प्रति- √ 1. -गॄ.)
अभि-प्रति-√ पद् P. (fut. -पत्स्यति) to begin with or at (acc.), AitBr.
अभि-प्रति-√ पिष् (perf. -पिपेष) to dash or crush out, ŚBr.
अभि-प्रत्य्-अव-√ रुह् to step down upon (acc.), AitBr.
अभि-प्रत्य्-अवे (√ इ) to move down towards, ŚBr.
अभि-प्रत्य्-ए (√ इ) to come back towards (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-प्रव m. = अभि-प्लव below, Kāṭh.
अभि-प्र-√ वह् to carry or bring towards, AitBr.
अभि-प्रवर्तन n. coming or flowing forth (said of the sweat), Suśr.
a: अभिप्रवर्तनं — 1 Advancing up to. --2 Proceeding, acting. --3 Flowing, coming forth, as of sweat.

v: na॰ aBitaH pravarttanam । 1 sarvataH pravfttO 2 sarvataH pravfttisampAdane ca “tvakKAdoromaharzaSca svedasyABipravarttanam” suSrutaH

m: अभि-प्र-वेश m. entering into, MBh. i, 2871.
अभि-प्र-√ वृध् Caus. -वर्धयति (generally used in the perf. Pass. p. -वर्धित) to enlarge, Suśr.; render prosperous, MBh.

अभि-प्र-√ वृत् Ā. to advance up to (acc.), AitBr.; KauṣUp.; to disembogue into (acc.), R.; to go forth, advance, ĀśvGṛ.; (see also अभि-प्र-वृत्त) : Caus. -वर्तयति, to cause to advance against, throw against (acc.), TS.; (dat.), SV.
a: अभिप्रवृत् — {c1c} A. 1 To advance up to, approach, go up to. --2 To fall or flow into; यत्र भागीरथीं गंगां यमुनाऽभिप्रवर्तते Rām. --3 To become conversant with. --Caus. To roll onward or towards.

m: अभि-प्रवृत्त mfn. being performed, advancing, proceeding, MBh. viii, 3464
occupied or engaged in Bhag.
a: अभिप्रवृत्त — p. p. 1 Advancing, going up to. --2 Occurring. --3 Engaged or occupied in (with loc.); Bg. 4. 20.

m: अभि-प्र-√ वृष् to pour down rain, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-√ विश् to disembogue into (acc.), BhP.
अभि-प्र-√ विप् (Opt. 3. pl. -वेपेरन्) to move against (acc.), threaten, TS.
अभि-प्र-विष्ट mfn. fallen or come into (acc.), R.
अभि-प्र-√ व्रज् to step or advance towards, ChUp.; KauṣUp.
अभि-प्रव्रजन n. advancing, ĀpŚr.
अभि-प्र-√ या (Imper. 2. pl. -याथन) to come towards, approach, RV. viii, 27, 6; to set out, march off, go to battle, MBh. &c.
अभि-प्र-यायम् ind. so as to approach, KātyŚr.
अभि-प्र-यायिन् mfn. approaching, TS.
अभि-प्र-√ युज् -प्र-युङ्क्ते, to seize, grasp, bring in one's possession, TS.; TBr.; KauṣBr.
अभि-प्रे (√ इ), -प्रैति (Imper. 2. sg. -प्रेहि 2. pl. प्रेत, RV.; AV.) to go near to, approach; to approach with one's mind, to think of Pāṇ. i, 4, 32, &c.; to aim at, intend.
a: अभिप्रे — [अभिप्र-इ] {c2c} P. 1 To go to or near, approach; कर्मणा यमभिप्रैति स संप्रदानं P. I. 4. 32. --2 To intend, aim at, think of, mean; cf. अभिप्रेत.

m: अभि-प्रेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्), (generally ind.p. -प्रेष्य) to look at, to see, view, MBh. &c.

v: tri॰ aBi + pra + Apa--sana--u । prAptumicCO “sahAsanamaBiprepsurutkfzwasyApakfzwajaH” “EndraM sTAnamaBiprepsuH” iti ca manuH ।
m: अभि-प्रेप्सु mfn. desirous of gaining, Mn. &c.
अभि-प्रेप्सु See अभि-प्राप्.
अभि-प्रेर् (√ ईर्), Caus. -प्रेरयति to drive forwards, push on Suśr.
अभि-प्रेरण n. pushing, setting in motion (as a see-saw).

s: tri, (aBi + pra + in + ktaH .) aBiprAyavizayIBUtaM । aBIzwaM । yaTA, -- “kAmAya tu hitaM kAmyamaBipretArTasidDaye । pArbbaRena viDAnena tadapyaktaM KagADipa” ॥ iti BavizyapurARaM ॥ (vAYCitaH । sammataH .)
v: tri॰ aBi + pra + iRa--kta । 1 aBilazite “aBipretArTasidDirmaNgalam “kAmAya tu Bavet kAmyamaBipretArTasidDaye” Bavi॰ pu॰ ।
m: अभि-प्रेत mfn. meant, intended, R. &c.
accepted, approved, Nir. &c.
to whom one's heart is devoted, dear, MBh.; Śāk. &c.
a: अभिप्रेत — p. p. 1 Meant, aimed at, intended; designed; अत्रायमर्थोऽभिप्रेतः; किमभिप्रेतमनया Bh. 3. 67; निवेदयाभिप्रेतं Pt. 1. --2 Wished, desired; यथाभिप्रेतमनुष्ठीयतां H. 1. --3 Approved, accepted; पूर्वैरयमभिप्रेतो गतो मार्गोनुगम्यते Rām. --4 Dear or agreeable to, favourite with, beloved; धर्मस्तवाभिप्रेतः Dk. 42; Ś. 6. --5 Wishing.

v: avya॰ aBi + pra + iRa--lyap । 1 uddiSyetyarTa । “yadaBipretya DAtvarTastatsampradAnamiti” vyAkaraRAntaram
m: अभि-प्रेत्य ind. intending, meaning by, Nir.
अभि-प्रेष् (√ 1. इष्), (1. sg. -प्रेष्यामि) to summon, command, AV.
अभि-प्रेषण n. sending out (messengers), Daś.
अभि-प्रेषित mfn. that which has been commanded or ordered, (अन्- neg.), ŚBr.
अभि-प्रियतमम् ind. in the presence of a beloved person, Śiś.

v: na॰ aBitaH prokzaRaM saMskfraBedaH । 1 jalAdinA sarvataH secanarUpe rvaDe saMskAre ।
m: अभि-प्रोक्षण n. (√ उक्ष्), sprinkling upon, affusion.
a: अभिप्रोक्षणं — Sprinkling upon.

m: अभि-√ प्रु to hasten near or towards, RV. iv, 58, 8; to jump into, ŚBr.
अभि-√ प्रुष् -प्रुष्णुते, -प्रुषायति [RV. x, 26, 3], to sprinkle with, RV.
अभि-√ पुथ् Caus. -पोथयति, to throw with violence upon (loc.), Hariv.

v: pu॰ aBitaH puzpamasya । 1 sarvataH puzpavati vfkze ।
m: अभि-पुष्प mfn. covered with flowers, R.
अभि-पुष्प n. an excellent flower, L.
a: अभिपुष्प — a. [अभितः पुष्पाण्यस्य] Covered over with flowers (as a tree). --ष्पं An excellent flower.

m: अभि-√ प्यै (perf. Ā. p. -पीप्यान) to swell, abound with (instr.), RV. vii, 36, 6.
